pages.title: Trang chủ
pages.prompt:
Create a high-fidelity raster UI design review board for a MULTI-PAGE corporate website CEC JSC, in Vietnamese. This is a dedicated page design, NOT a one-page landing page. Latest client priorities: modern beautiful custom design; source seafood website provides content only, NEVER imitate its template; UI clear and easy to use. Use reference image 1 (modern A homepage) for consistent visual language and image 2 for the original CEC JSC logo only (ignore questionnaire). Modern ocean-blue/navy, white, modest yellow CTA accents, clean sans-serif Vietnamese typography, generous whitespace, subtle 12-16px image corners, no decorative waves, no diagonal panels, no needless large gradients, no fabricated stats. Maintain logo faithfully without stretching. IMPORTANT output is ONE high-resolution 4K portrait review board per page with THREE COMPLETE WEBPAGE MOCKUPS side by side, enough resolution to zoom in. Board title above outside UI: PAGE_TITLE. Columns labeled 'Desktop — 1440 px', 'Tablet — 768 px', 'Điện thoại — 390 px'. Represent correct proportional responsive widths: desktop widest, tablet medium, mobile narrow. Show full scrollable content for all three variants, mobile taller, NEVER just place the desktop site inside a phone. Each view must depict the SAME page and SAME content adapted: desktop 3-column becomes tablet 2-column and phone 1-column; large desktop split sections stack on phone; headings wrap gracefully; mobile buttons full width with >=44px touch targets, legible text, no horizontal overflow. Desktop header: CEC logo and name, 6-menu links 'Trang chủ', 'Giới thiệu', 'Sản phẩm', 'Nhà máy', 'Tin tức', 'Liên hệ', 'VI | EN'; highlight correct active link. Tablet/phone header compact logo + 'VI | EN' + a clearly labeled 'Menu' control (not obscure icon-only). Internal pages include breadcrumb with 'Trang chủ' and correct page name. Footer has clear page links and CEC JSC brand; on phone stack footer. No browser chrome or hardware devices consuming room, simple screenshot panel borders. UI controls have understandable Vietnamese text. Reuse the visual language, not the homepage content on every page. No invented legal full name, founding year for CEC, addresses, contacts, awards, certifications, dated news or project claims. Include a small note OUTSIDE panels: 'Đề xuất giao diện · Hình ảnh minh họa · Chưa chốt thiết kế'. Keep image and all Vietnamese labels sharp, correctly accented.
PAGE_TITLE: Trang chủ. Active menu Trang chủ. This page only is the overview. Header then modern inset rounded coastline/aquaculture photo hero with title 'Kết nối giá trị. Phát triển bền vững.', supporting text 'Hệ sinh thái CEC JSC', two clear CTA buttons 'Khám phá CEC' and 'Liên hệ'. On mobile hero text remains readable with restrained image crop, not tiny. Beneath clear three-sector shortcut cards: Thủy sản, Sữa, Khu đô thị. Introduction heading 'Cùng nhau kiến tạo tương lai' and brief text about CEC and Thong Thuan seafood expertise (not invented corporate claims). Read-more link 'Về CEC JSC' goes to separate About page. Three sector photo previews with text below images and explicit 'Xem lĩnh vực'. Factory preview with heading 'Hệ thống nhà máy Thông Thuận', source-based locations Phan Rang, Cam Ranh, Trà Vinh, Sa Đéc, CTA 'Xem nhà máy' goes to separate page. Source-based activity preview 'Khám phá hoạt động Thông Thuận', CTA 'Xem tin tức'. Modest contact call-to-action then footer. Homepage introduces other pages instead of including full product catalog, full news articles or contact form.

about_revision: Edit this three-device website mockup board for the 'Giới thiệu' page. Keep EXACTLY the same board layout, three columns, page hierarchy, header, navigation, logo, photography, all sections, typography and colors. Change ONLY the paragraph under 'Hệ sinh thái CEC JSC' in ALL THREE device views (desktop, tablet, phone). Replace it with natural public-facing Vietnamese brand copy: 'CEC JSC định hướng phát triển các lĩnh vực thủy sản, sữa và khu đô thị.
